map.化妆品质量标准检查体系，涵盖感官/理化/微生物/包装四维质量评估: A cosmetic quality standards inspection system covering sensory, physicochemical, microbiological and packaging dimensions
map.加权综合得分 = Σ（各指标得分 × 指标权重）÷ Σ（满分 4 × 指标权重）: Weighted composite score = Σ (metric score × metric weight) ÷ Σ (4 × metric weight) × 100%. Metrics are scored excellent 4, good 3, fair 2, poor 1. Dimension ratings follow the score rate (≥ 90% excellent, 75% to 89% good, 60% to 74% fair, below 60% poor). Any metric scoring 2 or below is put on the improvement list and prioritised in descending weight order.
map.对每个检查项评分（优=4/良=3/中=2/差=1），系统自动计算质量综合得分与提: Score each inspection item (excellent=4/good=3/fair=2/poor=1) and the system automatically computes the composite quality score with improvement suggestions
map.综合得分 = 各项加权平均: Composite score = weighted average of all items
map.建议定期检查并持续改进质量管理水平: Inspect regularly and keep improving quality management
map.📚 深度解析：化妆品质量体系检查: 📚 In-depth analysis: cosmetic quality system inspection
map.品牌方按感官、理化、微生物、包装标识四维度给新品打分。: Brands score a new product across four dimensions: sensory, physicochemical, microbiological and packaging labelling.
map.质检员对照标准逐项评分，输出综合得分与改进建议。: QC staff score each item against the standards and produce a composite score with improvement suggestions.
map.代工厂接单前自评成熟度，判断能否达到客户质量要求。: Contract manufacturers self-assess maturity before accepting an order to judge whether they can meet the client's quality requirements.
map.设感官 85 分、理化 90 分、微生物 95 分、包装标识 80 分（满分各: Set sensory 85, physicochemical 90, microbiological 95 and packaging labelling 80 (100 each), with weights 0.3/0.3/0.25/0.15. The composite = 85×0.3 + 90×0.3 + 95×0.25 + 80×0.15 = 88.25 points, reaching grade A (≥ 85) though packaging labelling could be optimized.
map.微生物这项为什么权重高？: Why does microbiology carry such a high weight?
map.微生物超标直接关系使用安全（致病菌、防腐剂失效），是合规红线，故权重高于外观类指: Microbial contamination directly affects usage safety (pathogens, failed preservatives) and is a compliance red line, so it is weighted above appearance-oriented metrics.
map.综合得分低先改哪一项？: If the composite score is low, which item should I fix first?
map.优先改低分项中权重高且易改进的，如包装标识不规范、感官稳定性；理化与微生物需从配: Prioritise low-scoring items that are both high-weight and easy to improve, such as non-compliant packaging labelling and sensory stability. Physicochemical and microbiological issues have to be solved at the formula and process level.
map.化妆品质量标准检查评估体系，从感官指标、理化指标、微生物指标和包装标识四个维度全: A cosmetic quality standards inspection and assessment system that checks product quality across four dimensions — sensory indicators, physicochemical indicators, microbiological indicators and packaging labelling — and outputs a weighted composite score, per-dimension ratings and targeted improvement suggestions.
map.四维质量评估（感官/理化/微生物/包装）: Four-dimension quality assessment (sensory / physicochemical / microbiological / packaging)
map.加权评分，突出关键指标: Weighted scoring that highlights key metrics
map.可视化各维度质量水平: Visualizes the quality level of each dimension
